name: dsa-arcade
description: DSA Arcade - Learn & Debug: interactive DSA learning and secure code judging platform

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @dsa/backend && npm run build -w @dsa/worker
scripts.dev:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @dsa/backend
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @dsa/worker
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @dsa/backend && npm run test -w @dsa/worker
scripts.test:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @dsa/backend
scripts.test:worker: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @dsa/worker
